services.name: Swim Team
services.desc: Group Lessons: Offered in three sessions (morning & evening), Monday-Friday, 30 minutes/day, rain or shine (You will be contacted only in cases of severe weather cancellations.) Registration: May close early as sessions fill, at the discretion of the manager. Note that no refunds will be issue Registrations for group swim lessons may be cancelled prior to the start of the session. Cancellations made before the session begins will receive a 75% refund of the registration fee. Once a session has started, refunds will not be issued for missed classes, schedule conflicts, illness, or participant withdrawal. Lessons may occasionally be cancelled due to weather, pool conditions, or instructor
